git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Spec §5.1: user requires systematic ban of gaode-maps for non-{timeline,transportation} subagents at both harness and prompt layers. Pre-existing tool-policy.v1.json has zero of the 8 required keys; pre-existing hook has no gaode classifier; 7 banned agents have positive gaode instructions and no DO-NOT block.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Authoritative harness layer: 8 policy keys + 6 surface matchers wired through pretool-tool-policy.py + identity-default-deny on missing agent_id. Defense-in-depth prompt layer: 7 DO-NOT blocks + removal of every imperative gaode invocation line. Verification harness proves all 30 cases bind correctly.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: BA spec requires 8 new policy keys + 6 surface matchers (each requiring a separate matcher fn for testability) + 7 DO-NOT blocks (21 lines each, identical-by-design) + 78-line verification harness (Could-Have #8, BA-required). The matcher functions are minimum-sized — each is a 4-9 line scan; the size comes from the surface count, not from over-engineering. Per-function decomposition is mandated by the quality gate (30-line + 3-level caps), not an aesthetic choice. The 7 DO-NOT blocks are required by AC7 to be present in every non-allowlist project agent.
